description: A standardized youth assessment subtest that measures adolescents’ ability to judge the effectiveness of alternative actions for achieving emotion-regulation goals, developed as part of the Mayer, Salovey, and Caruso Emotional Intelligence Test—Youth Version.
title: MSCEIT-YV Emotion Regulation Ability subtest

description: MSWeight is a multimodal weight-management counseling curriculum for medical students, comprising web-based instruction, role-play, web-patient feedback, and enhanced clerkship training, developed by Ockene and colleagues.
title: MSWeight
